headline: As of 2026-10-29: 43,661,559 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+9.9 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 43,661,559 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+9.9 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (6,264,074), California (4,288,495), Florida (4,066,168).
